_comment: Xros Wars' own selection table, read out of its firmware at 0x2427A. Fifteen rows of four pool indexes -- five stages by three effort tiers, four Excite bands each. Indexed by the monster record's w1, which is stage - 1.
watched: Shoutmon X2 threw stage 4 tier 1; every other Xros form tried threw stage 4 tier 2; a maximum-effort Shoutmon threw stage 3 tier 2. All three are reproduced by this table, which is what showed the axis was EFFORT and not the Digimon.
